story: Parashurama, son of the sage Jamadagni and Renuka, is the sixth avatar of Vishnu: a brahmin who took up the axe given to him by Shiva. When King Kartavirya Arjuna seized his father's sacred cow, and the king's sons later killed Jamadagni, Parashurama swore revenge and wiped out the corrupt warrior kings of the earth twenty-one times.
belief: He is worshipped as the sixth avatar and as a chiranjeevi, said to be meditating still on Mahendra mountain. Legend says he threw his axe into the sea, and the land of Kerala and the Konkan coast rose from the water.
turns: At his father's command he cut off his own mother's head, then used the boon his father offered to bring her back to life. He cursed his student Karna to forget his knowledge when he discovered Karna had lied about his birth.
facts: He taught Bhishma, Drona and Karna.
Parashurama Jayanti is celebrated on Akshaya Tritiya.
Tradition says he will be the teacher of Kalki, the avatar still to come.
